about: Validator policy. Tiers: 0 = listed lexicon forms, 1 = regular inflection from a trusted stem, 2 = extended (grammatical but not backed by a flag).

extended.about: hybrid + tanween alif and unflagged sound plurals

basic.about: Basic mode has no hamza / ة / ى tiles, so a word is compared by its 28-letter spelling. Use policy 'strict' to require the exact orthography instead. Words with a stand-alone ء cannot be spelled in Basic mode.

bank.about: Big word bank compiled by tools/build-bank.mjs. 'strong' = corroborated words (accepted, source 'bank'); 'weak' = isolated words. weak: 'uncertain' (provisional, Tahkim can rule) | 'accept' | 'reject'. 'mined' = stems the bank proves exist (tools/mine-bank.mjs), completed by the morphology rules (tools/build-mined.mjs).

shortWords.about: Words of up to maxLength letters that ONLY the word bank vouches for (no rule, no mined stem, no hand-written entry) are the densest source of generator noise: they are reported uncertain (provisional) instead of valid. bankOnly: 'uncertain' | 'accept' | 'reject'. Set maxLength to 0 to trust the bank at every length.
